sdkPath.title: Flutter SDK path
sdkPath.description: Optional path to a Flutter SDK root or `flutter` executable. Leave empty to use FVM or PATH.

useFvm.title: Use FVM when .fvm exists
useFvm.description: Automatically invoke `fvm flutter` when a `.fvm` directory is present.

defaultFlavor.title: Default flavor
defaultFlavor.description: Optional --flavor value passed to profile/release runs and builds.
